situation: Bearing distributor (EUR 47 m, family) holding 70% of the 6306 and all of the 7309; frame ends 2026-12-31 and it wants to renew the 6306 (P04). It is refocusing on key accounts: individual agreements will not be extended, standard items from stock at list, Hollerau 'not strategic'. But its owner offered to walk us through the calculation, and it states that only multi-year volume agreements change prices. Bearing PPI +0.8% yoy, so no cost case for increases; its quality has slipped (ppm 81 -> 329).
